title: Excellent All-Purpose Kitchen Timer With Independent Memory Function
text:
Excellent All-Purpose Kitchen Timer With Independent Memory Function. EDITED August 11, 2012:
After about 4 months of use, the part of the display that shows the second number for the minutes went partially blank. This happened even though the timer had not been dropped, and had not gotten wet. The timer still keeps track of the time, so it's still useable. However, because of the defective display, I'm reducing my star rating from 5 stars to 3 stars ("it's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
This battery-operated CDN Digital Timer is a terrific all-purpose kitchen timer. A slider on the side makes it simple to switch between the three main functions: (1) an accurate 24-hour digital clock, (2) a count-up timer (stopwatch), and (3) a count-down timer (food timer). The display shows time in hours, minutes, and seconds-- the maximum time is 23 hours, 59 minutes, 59 seconds. The timer is powered by a single flat, round LR44 battery (included).

The timer's best feature is the independent memory function that will recall your most frequently used time setting. I keep the memory set at 20 minutes--the time it takes to freeze homemade ice cream--but the memory can be easily erased and reset to something different whenever you like. You do NOT have to set the timer and allow it to run to completion to invoke the memory function (a requirement with many other kitchen timers). Instead, the memory is set independently, by using the regular Hr.-Min.-Sec. buttons and then hitting the Memory button. The timer has a built-in stand, plus a fairly strong magnet that you can use to attach the device to any convenient metal surface.

I rate this timer at 5 stars ("I love it" on the official Amazon scale). The only negative thing I have to say about it, is that it is quite small. At 2" high by 2-5/8" wide, it is slightly smaller than a credit card. Because my household has two cooks, I use this timer alongside another excellent timer, the [[ASIN:B004PYA3B8 Robic Three Memory Timer]], which is limited to 99 minutes but which remembers three frequently used time settings.

product_metadata.title: CDN Digital Timer and Clock Memory Feature, 6.8 x 4.5 x 0.9 inches, Cream
features: Digital timer/clock has memory for retiming repetitive events
Perfect for timing game moves or baking cookies
Counts up or down, 24 hours by seconds
Compact size with pocket clip, Stand, and magnet

Measuring a trim 2-5/8 by 2 by 1/2 inches, this super-compact timer can stand on a table, slip into a shirt pocket, or magnetically attach to a refrigerator. The timer counts either up to or down from 24 hours by seconds, and its digital memory feature makes it ideal for repetitive timings, such as baking cookies and board game moves. After reaching zero, the timer begins counting up so you know how much time has elapsed since the first alarm beeps. Clearly marked buttons and a red function switch make the timer easy to use, and the alarms extra-loud staccato beeps can be heard over the din of a childrens birthday party. CDN covers the digital timer with a five-year warranty against defects. One button battery is included for operation.
